testimonials.quote: "Some of our most remarkable feats of leadership in New Zealand have been carried out by ordinary people.  People like Sam Johnson who organised the Student Volunteer Army in the wake of the Christchurch earthquakes."

testimonials.title: Former Governor-General of New Zealand

testimonials.quote: "This young man mobilised the Student Army… and made a huge impression on New Zealand."

testimonials.quote: "Sam Johnson demonstrates incredible strength and leadership capabilities well beyond age."
testimonials.author: Sir Peter Blake Trust
